messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 Saturnia - enterprise-vpc - elevated error rate on dedicated pool saturnia-prod-1. 5xxs up ~6% last 3m. @oncall-alex you're up. https://redwood/incidents/4198765432 :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: Acknowledged. Joining bridge now. @eng-maya can you pull perf dashboard?

eng-maya: joining. pulling traces and model KPIs. initial look: token-timeout spikes, KV cache miss rate up on saturnia model variant v3-q8_256.

sre-jordan: FYI telemetry shows node eviction in the pool ~00:41 UTC causing reroutes to fallback variants; some requests hitting a slower safe variant with higher latency.

cust-kal: Saturnia ops team reports customer-visible failures for batch summarization jobs (timeouts ~30s) and higher latency for real-time chat. They're seeing ~12% API error rate in last 10m. Customers are paged.

oncall-alex: Ok plan: 1) Pin Saturnia tenant to safevariant v3-safe-1 in the VPC routing table 2) Temporarily increase capacity on dedicated pool (scale up + add capacity) 3) Short-term circuit to dedicated fallback model for writes only. Thoughts?

eng-maya: I can push pin via routing API. Example command:
```
POST /v1/routing/pin
{ "tenant_id": "saturnia", "model": "v3-safe-1", "duration": "30m", "reason": "emergency fallback - latency spike" }
```
I'll run that after 👍 from SRE.

sre-jordan: Approve pin. Also we should enable `prefer_cached_kv=true` flag on the dedicated nodes to reduce cold-kv fetches. Small config patch:
```
service.config.kv_prefetch: true
```

acct-erin: Noted on cost impact; temporary scale up accepted for mitigation window. Please tag the incident so we can reconcile.

pm-lena: Customer success wants a brief note for Saturnia with ETA. Keep me posted on fallback duration.

cust-kal: Confirmed: customer's full-run jobs failing; they want progress updates every 10m.

oncall-alex: eng-maya - execute pin and kv_prefetch change. sre-jordan - trigger pool scale. I'll post to bridge.

eng-maya: Pin applied: routing response 200. Tenant Saturnia now pinned -> v3-safe-1. Logs: `pin_id=pin-9b2a`.

sre-jordan: Scaling dedicated pool +2 instances, health checks passing. Applying kv_prefetch flag; rolling restart of 2 nodes in sequence.

cust-kal: Initial customer confirmation: timeouts dropped, error rate down to ~3% after pin. They still see slightly elevated latency but functional.

oncall-alex: Good. Set incident status -> mitigated. Assign follow-ups: 1) root cause triage (eng-maya) 2) postmortem (PM+SRE) 3) ensure model variant health checks improved (eng-ml).

eng-maya: Noted. I'll collect KV cache pressure graphs and model memory profiles. Will llok into why v3-q8_256 had increased cold misses.

sre-jordan: Handoff to follow-up runbook. Paging cleared. I'll hand to oncall rotation tomorrow.

pm-lena: I'll draft customer update and coordinate a post-incident call. Thanks team :pray:

incident-bot: Incident closed -> mitigated by routing pin + capacity scale at 4198765478.
